environment.scope: Linux software-only development run: scripted ACP peer, fake SDK tree/preview worker and the engine's real controller (plus an installed SDK only when --real-sdk-active is given). Authentic gates need a real authenticated adapter, physical devices or other operating systems and are recorded separately.

git.fingerprint_note: digest of `git diff HEAD` plus untracked files, excluding desktop/qualification

dev_acp_transport.criteria: ACP v1 driver tests (acp_v1, acp_v1_review) pass against the scripted peer: negotiation, streaming, permissions, cancellation, bounds, redaction.

dev_engine_transactions.criteria: Engine agent-task, candidate-validation, edit-transaction, promotion, history and crash-recovery suites pass.

dev_workflow_fixture.criteria: The AgentWorkflow integration suite passes against the scripted peer, fake preview worker and real controller.

dev_tools_and_validation.criteria: Project tool broker/CLI/MCP, shared build service, candidate runner and preview handoff suites pass.

dev_native_ui_workflow.criteria: The native conversation panel / shell workflow test target (agent_workflow_ui: controls, permission and clarification cards, paging inside the resident limits, UI preview-handoff sink and acknowledgement) passes against the scripted peer.

dev_native_x11_shell.criteria: The production GPUI shell on an owned Xvfb (scripted peer, real SDK, software rendering) sends a prompt through native input after a baseline preview stepped to a non-zero playhead; the media-changing edit is adopted via adopt_promotion and displayed with matching video/audio revision and a changed audio digest, a fresh transport epoch, the playhead position/frame/PCM window retained and the awaiting label cleared; Undo restores the original audio through another matching hand-off under yet another epoch. Writer containment is the explicit test-only injection, not a qualification. NOT a provider, physical-display, physical-audio or IME qualification.

dev_resource_bounds.criteria: Under a long streamed transcript resident rows <= 400 and bytes <= 4 MiB (+ the newest row), older rows are paged, the 256-event queue never overflows and nothing is owned after close.
dev_resource_bounds.notes: Streamed 1499 rows (4800000 text bytes, 1527 scripted events against a 256-event queue); peak resident 400/400 rows and 4191702/4194304 bytes (rule: at most one newest row over the byte budget); older rows paged from disk; no queue overflow; nothing owned after close. Fixture scripted peer only; playback/scrub concurrency and GPU layout cost were not measured.

dev_compiler_count.criteria: The shared BuildService starts exactly one compile per equal build key (UI/tool/validation subscribers), one per distinct key and per accepted edit.
dev_compiler_count.notes: 5 equal-key requests (UI, tool, validation, tool, cache hit) started 1 compile (3 joins); a different revision started exactly one more; each of 20 accepted edits compiled once through the shared service (30 compiles in all cycles, repair attempts included).

dev_cleanup_cycles.criteria: At least 20 accepted edits and 20 failed/cancelled tasks leave zero owned processes, broker capabilities, build leases and materializations, checked after every cycle and after close.
dev_cleanup_cycles.notes: 20 accepted edits and 10 failed + 10 cancelled tasks (repair exhausted, provider crash, Stop while editing, Stop while waiting for permission): zero owned processes, broker capabilities, tool workers, build leases and capability files after every cycle; after close also zero materializations, runtime-dir entries and live adapter processes (45 adapters started). Scripted peer only.

dev_cli_mcp_parity.criteria: studio-tools and studio-mcp return identical project_context/timeline/inspect/render_frame results against the same broker capability.
dev_cli_mcp_parity.notes: project_context, timeline, inspect and render_frame answered identically through studio-tools and studio-mcp against the same broker (only the per-call artifact id, path and expiry stamp dropped; rendered PNG hash identical); capability died with the task. Fake preview worker; no comparison with the project CLI on a real SDK, no real MCP client.

dev_publication_primitive.criteria: The Linux Apply gate selects atomic renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) on the project filesystem and refuses a link-only filesystem.
dev_publication_primitive.notes: Linux 6.8.0-142-generic, project filesystem ext4 (/dev/vda2): the Apply gate selected Renameat2; a link-only filesystem blocks Apply (link fallback refused for live names).

dev_real_sdk_workflow.criteria: The ignored real-SDK workflow/promotion tests pass with a real Cargo compile and real preview worker (scripted agent).

auth_adapter_probe_v1.criteria: A REAL ACP adapter initializes, negotiates protocol v1, reports Ready auth through a scratch session (no prompt) and its capabilities are recorded.
auth_adapter_probe_v1.notes: @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp 0.85.1 negotiated ACP v1 and created a scratch session (auth route: adapter-managed sign-in (no environment variables forwarded)); capabilities recorded. No prompt was sent, no edit was made and no writer containment is claimed: only the handshake is qualified.

auth_two_edit_undo_restart.criteria: In a real generated/imported project with a real authenticated adapter: brief -> playable result A, second edit -> B, Undo to A, restart, committed acceptance recovered; timeline/frame/audio/revision identities and source/Git/draft inventories checked at every step.
auth_two_edit_undo_restart.notes: Not run on this machine: the prerequisite below is missing. No fixture or development evidence is substituted for it.
auth_two_edit_undo_restart.prerequisite: a real ACP adapter executable and a signed-in provider account (none exists on this machine), an installed SDK and an operator-driven native session. No automated driver for a live provider session exists in this repository; this harness cannot run the gate and a scripted-peer run is never a substitute.

auth_writer_process_group.criteria: The real adapter's writer processes are proven to stay inside the spawned process group (including after Stop and a provider crash), so WriterOwnership may be ProcessGroupContained for that adapter.
auth_writer_process_group.notes: Not run on this machine: the prerequisite below is missing. No fixture or development evidence is substituted for it.
auth_writer_process_group.prerequisite: a real ACP adapter executable and a signed-in provider account (none exists on this machine), observed through its real process tree. Until then ownership stays Unknown/Detached and automatic Apply is not qualified for any provider; the scripted peer proves the engine's gate only.

auth_compiler_error_repair.criteria: An authentic task deliberately introduces a compiler error: structured repair context reaches the agent and exactly one repair attempt runs.
auth_compiler_error_repair.notes: Not run on this machine: the prerequisite below is missing. No fixture or development evidence is substituted for it.
auth_compiler_error_repair.prerequisite: a real ACP adapter executable and a signed-in provider account (none exists on this machine), an installed SDK and an operator-run brief that provokes a compile error.

auth_interaction_and_failure_modes.criteria: With the real adapter: permission requests, clarification, Stop in every phase, provider crash, external source conflict, and interrupted publication/Undo with restart leave recoverable data and no stuck writer.
auth_interaction_and_failure_modes.notes: Not run on this machine: the prerequisite below is missing. No fixture or development evidence is substituted for it.
auth_interaction_and_failure_modes.prerequisite: a real ACP adapter executable and a signed-in provider account (none exists on this machine); the conflict and interrupted-publication runs also need an operator able to edit the project externally and kill the app mid-publication.

auth_mcp_cli_support.criteria: The real adapter accepts the stdio MCP server in session/new and/or runs the studio-tools command, and project tools work through that route.
auth_mcp_cli_support.notes: Not run on this machine: the prerequisite below is missing. No fixture or development evidence is substituted for it.
auth_mcp_cli_support.prerequisite: a real ACP adapter executable and a signed-in provider account (none exists on this machine) that honors stdio MCP servers (and one that can run shell commands for the studio-tools route); MCP_QUALIFICATION is unqualified against any provider until then.

auth_twenty_cycle_cleanup.criteria: At least 20 edit or failed-task cycles with the real adapter leave no owned process, broker capability or materialization/PCM lease after close.
auth_twenty_cycle_cleanup.notes: Not run on this machine: the prerequisite below is missing. No fixture or development evidence is substituted for it.
auth_twenty_cycle_cleanup.prerequisite: a real ACP adapter executable and a signed-in provider account (none exists on this machine) and provider quota for 20 real edit/failure cycles.

auth_visual_ime.criteria: The native conversation panel is verified with real IME composition, focus and Tab order, transcript scroll while streaming, and Space/timeline shortcuts not stolen from the focused prompt.
auth_visual_ime.notes: Not run on this machine: the prerequisite below is missing. No fixture or development evidence is substituted for it.
auth_visual_ime.prerequisite: A native desktop session with a real input method (IME) and an operator; the Linux Xvfb software-rendering runs do not exercise IME or GPU presentation.

auth_physical_audio.criteria: Promoted-revision audio handoff and the M2 output-clock behavior are measured on a physical audio output device and real display presentation.
auth_physical_audio.notes: Not run on this machine: the prerequisite below is missing. No fixture or development evidence is substituted for it.
auth_physical_audio.prerequisite: A physical audio output device and display on a native desktop; real_cpal_* tests need a real CPAL output device and none exists on this machine.
